_about: PUBLICTONE-1: wording the public pages (README.md, docs/*.md) may not carry. tools/publish_check.py reads this file; see the comment above `tone()` there. refused: whole words or phrases, any case; a line break or several spaces between the words still match, `*` and backticks are ignored, and a word joined to another by `-` or `_` (best-effort, a config key) is not a match. needs: a phrase allowed only in a sentence that also carries its qualifier. counted: a word with a per-file ceiling, set to the count on 2026-10-01; a page not listed has ceiling 0.
